representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape = comparison-panel for location-sensitive options (few, high-density, comparison required). Both viewports show a side-by-side multi-attribute table (月租/面积/通勤/地铁/噪音/采光/楼层/便利度/公园/综合得分) of 3 pinned locations with per-row best highlighting and #1–#3 rank badges, next to a schematic city map with office marker and 5 candidate pins (screenshots/1280x860.png, screenshots/1440x900.png; source/index.html:240-258, :130-137). Max 4 comparison slots (index.html:138) matches 'few'.

primary_task_salience.evidence: The decide verdict dominates the initial screen: header badge '推荐 B · 望山巷（综合 65 分）' top-right in both screenshots (index.html:89, :264-265); comparison table occupies ~2/3 of the viewport; map card headline states the primary interaction '点击图钉加入/移出对比' (index.html:94).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: panel titles state the object and rule outright — '区位图 · 点击图钉加入/移出对比', '并排对比 · 比较状态驻留本屏' (index.html:94, :108); map legend decodes pin colors and isochrones (index.html:97-102); ▲ + green best-cell highlights and the #1 green rank chip let the winner be read at a glance (screenshots both viewports; index.html:59-60, :64-65); prose 决策备注 explains the win/loss vs runner-up (index.html:268).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object is on screen at load with zero modes or routes. Candidate add/remove = 1 click on a pin (index.html:198) or a bench chip (:275-279); weight sliders re-rank in place (:305-308). source/shots/02-four-candidates.png and 03-two-candidates.png show 4-way and 2-way comparison states reached within the same single screen.

context_loss.evidence: All actions render into the same screen; comparison state persists by design ('比较状态驻留本屏', index.html:108). No modal or navigation in source. Map↔table cross-highlight keeps spatial context during table hover (hot(), index.html:207-221); pins reflect membership (grayed .out) and winner (green + dashed ring) via syncPins (:282-291), visible across all three shots.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly the brief's needs: map+legend (location object), comparison table (comparison required, density high), 3 weight sliders + reset + verdict + decision note (decision inputs same-screen = success criterion), bench chips for set membership (index.html:86-124). No decorative chrome; transient tooltip/toast only. Both viewports render without clutter or dead panels.

accessibility.evidence: measurement-summary.json fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size (4/7 fail). Code corroborates: column-remove ✕ is a bare <span> with no tabindex/role, unreachable by keyboard (index.html:246, :262); .focus-ring CSS targets elements never created in buildMap/syncPins, so pins have no visible keyboard focus indicator (:34-35); low-contrast ✕ (#b9b3a4 on white, :61) and 10–11px map/rank text (:59, :181-187). Mitigations exist — pins carry role=button, aria-label, Enter/Space handlers (:195-199); svg/table have aria-labels (:96, :116) — but not enough to offset three failed a11y checks.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass and both screenshots render cleanly (measurement-summary.json; screenshots/1280x860.png, 1440x900.png). But 4/7 checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), each implying a remediation pass on shipped UI; target_invalid=false.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '地理语境与决策项同屏' is literally the layout: map (office star, dashed commute isochrones at 10/20/35min, parks, river) and the decision table are permanently co-screen in both operator screenshots; the header subtitle states the seed verbatim (index.html:88); isochrones tie commute numbers to geography (:184-188) and map tooltips surface rent/commute on the pins (:212-219).

defects_observed: 7-check receipt: 4 fail — a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json).
Column-remove ✕ is a click-only <span> (no tabindex/role/keyboard handler) — keyboard users cannot remove a candidate from comparison (source/index.html:246, :262).
.focus-ring CSS (:34-35) references elements never created anywhere in the script, so map pins have no visible keyboard focus indicator.
Sub-legible text sizes in shipped UI: 10px isochrone labels (:187), 11px park names (:181, :183) and 11px rank chips (:59), consistent with the type.min_projected_size failure.
scores.overall_note: This package is a close structural match to the brief: a single static index.html whose first paint is already the decision surface — a schematic map with office-centered commute isochrones beside a dense side-by-side comparison table, a weighted verdict badge, and a prose trade-off note, satisfying the acceptance seed (地理语境与决策项同屏) verbatim (source/index.html:88, :94, :108; both operator screenshots). Navigation cost and context loss are minimal: every action (pin click, chip click, sliders, ✕) re-renders in place with map↔table cross-highlighting (index.html:207-221, :282-291), and the included interaction shots show 4-way and 2-way states on the same screen with scores/ranks staying on a stable full-set normalization (:144). Data is inlined so there is no loading state (:129-137, :315-327). The clear weakness is accessibility: the sanitized receipt fails three a11y checks plus minimum type size, and the source confirms real causes (keyboard-unreachable remove control at :246, dead focus-ring CSS at :34-35, 10–11px labels), which also implies moderate rework despite zero layout/responsive/truncation defects. Scores for the three not_observable dimensions are withheld per rubric; model-judged time_to_understand is a proxy, not human preference.
